nodes.label: OK / Confirmation Checkmark Icon
nodes.description: A circular green glossy button with a white checkmark, typically used as an OK/confirm/success indicator in a UI dialog or button.
nodes.visual_style: green circle, glossy/3D button look, white check (tick) mark

nodes.label: Confirm / Accept Action
nodes.rationale: Green checkmark icons are a near-universal UI metaphor for confirming or accepting an action; the icon communicates a positive/success outcome to the user without requiring text labels.
